note: D9 starting spec for pour tea, written in tokens to mirror manip_sim/pour_stages.py: the carry holds teapot.up_axis to world.z (tight) with translation free (the path holds from the lifted entry, so no band there); the carry goal puts the spout tip centered (moderate) over the opening at clearance large / slack snug, the same band as the pour path, so the hand-off lies inside the pour's path; the pour tips teapot.front_axis to mug.-up (tight), a sweep about the teapot's lateral axis, with the spout tip held over the opening

emissions.name: grasp the teapot by its handle
emissions.verify: The gripper is closed on the handle with the grasp point at teapot.handle_center; the teapot is still upright at its spawn pose.
emissions.goal: The gripper closes on the teapot's handle at teapot.handle_center, with the teapot still upright at its spawn pose.

emissions.name: carry the teapot upright over the mug
emissions.verify: Along the carry teapot.+up stays vertical (no spill) while translation is free, so the lower spawn pose is admissible; at the goal teapot.spout_tip is centered over mug.opening_center at a large standoff that lifts the pot's lowest point clear of the mug rim and matches the pour stage's entry height, still upright.
emissions.goal: teapot.spout_tip ends up centered above mug.opening_center at a large standoff, so the whole pot body clears the mug rim, with teapot.+up still pointing the way world.z points.

emissions.name: pour
emissions.verify: Starting upright at the transport standoff, the teapot rotates about its level lateral axis (teapot.+left stays perpendicular to mug.+up) until teapot.+front points the way mug.-up points, with teapot.spout_tip staying centered over mug.opening_center at that same height throughout.
emissions.goal: The teapot tips forward in place about its lateral axis, keeping teapot.spout_tip centered over mug.opening_center at the transport standoff height, until teapot.+front points the way mug.-up points so tea falls into the mug.
